author: Michael Larabel
description: The open-source D7VK project that implements the Direct3D 7 / 6 / 5 / 3 APIs atop the Vulkan API for faster, modern performance is out with a new release. This new D7VK 2.4 release came as a bit of a surprise since it was just last month D7VK announced its maturity status and more or less in maintenance mode. But brought up in today's D7VK 2.4 announcement is an even bigger surprise: there's now an implementation of the 3Dfx Glide API atop Vulkan...
title: GXVK: 3Dfx Glide API Implemented Atop Vulkan For Modern Usage

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged to the kernel all the way back in Linux  2.6.26 in 2008 was KGDB for improving the kernel debugging experience. KGDB works in conjunction with the GNU Debugger (GDB) to debug the kernel in a similar fashion to user-space debugging. KGDB requires the use of a second computer connected via serial or network cable. KGDB isn't widely used in recent years and a patch was floated today to remove it from the Linux kernel...
title: Linux Kernel Developers Considering Removal Of KGDB Debugging Functionality

author: Michael Larabel
description: System76 began teasing today the new Thelio Prime Desktop as an AMD-powered Linux mini PC that will begin shipping in November...
title: System76 Introducing AMD-Powered Linux Small PC

author: Michael Larabel
description: Canonical engineers back in 2023 outlined plans for Ubuntu Core Desktop as their immutable Linux desktop. They made some good initial progress but since 2024 it went rather silent. Now they are reviving Ubuntu Core Desktop as their immutable desktop  OS offering and with grand plans for the future...
title: Canonical Reviving Their Immutable Ubuntu Core Desktop

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the recently released Ubuntu 26.10 and the nearly-released Fedora Workstation 45, Phoronix readers have begun inquiring about fresh benchmarks looking at how they stack up against the performance-optimized, Arch Linux based CachyOS. Up today are our first CachyOS vs. Fedora 45 vs. Ubuntu 26.10 benchmarks on an AMD Ryzen 9 9900X3D2 desktop system.
title: CachyOS vs. Fedora 45 vs. Ubuntu 26.10 Performance On AMD Ryzen 9

author: Michael Larabel
description: NetBSD-current has added a new command line text editor to its base set of packages for helping out new users as an alternative to their vi and xedit editors currently included...
title: NetBSD Adds Alternative Text Editor To vi & xedit For Easing New Users

author: Michael Larabel
description: Open-source developer Jamey Sharp who is a longtime X.Org developer and co-creator of the X protocol C-language Binding (XCB) finally had the need to write a Wayland client and ended up praising its design...
title: X.Org XCB Co-Creator Praises Wayland's Protocol Design

author: Michael Larabel
description: While the Linux kernel and various file-system drivers already support the notion of the birth time for tracking a file/directory's birth/creation time, a slightly different provenance time "ptime" is now being proposed for the Linux kernel...
title: Provenance Time Proposed As A New Timestamp For Linux

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those that want to reminisce  over the days long ago of Compiz and Beryl on the Linux desktop, the Hyprland 0.57 Wayland compositor released today and has added Compiz-inspired wobbly windows support...
title: Hyprland 0.57 Released With Compiz Inspired Wobbly Windows

author: Michael Larabel
description: Hans-Kristian Arntzen of Valve's Linux team just tagged the VKD3D-Proton 3.1 release. This version comes with a number of new features and performance optimizations while being the stable point ahead of VKD3D-Proton beginning to see a lot of new feature code for what will then become VKD3D-Proton 3.2...
title: VKD3D-Proton 3.1 Released With New Features Ahead Of Big v3.2 Release

author: Michael Larabel
description: GhostBSD 26.2 is out as the latest feature release of this FreeBSD-powered desktop operating system...
title: GhostBSD 26.2 Released As FreeBSD 15.1 Powered OS With New Installer

author: Michael Larabel
description: Paragon Software's Konstantin Komarov sent out the latest NTFS3 driver updates for this in-kernel NTFS read/write driver. With Linux 7.4, the NTFS3 driver is focused on being hardened against corrupted or maliciously-crafted NTFS volumes...
title: NTFS3 Hardened In Linux 7.4 Against Corrupted Or Maliciously-Crafted NTFS Volumes

author: Michael Larabel
description: A patch has been proposed to remove the BSD-Compress support from the Linux kernel for the Linux networking point-to-point protocol (PPP) due to being unmaintained and having fundamental issues with the code that can lead to a fatal error...
title: Retiring BSD-Compress Proposed For Linux PPP Network Code
